research_result.description: Brex is a unified spend management platform offering APIs and an official MCP server to integrate financial workflows, expense management, corporate cards, and transaction tracking.
research_result.credential_requirements: API credentials (user tokens) require an active Brex customer account and account/card admin access to sign into the dashboard and accept the developer API agreement. MCP connections support OAuth for any employee or API tokens generated by admins.

evidence.claim: Brex provides REST APIs defined with OpenAPI specifications.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs.

evidence.claim: Developer access requires being an existing Brex customer with dashboard admin privileges.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: This guide assumes you are a Brex customer with admin access to your dashboard.

evidence.claim: Brex APIs use user tokens passed as Bearer tokens in headers for authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.

evidence.claim: Brex maintains an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server supporting OAuth and API key auth.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions, track bills, and more through natural language.
